newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast unleaded, diesel prices drift lower.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast unleaded, diesel prices drift lower.

text.p: U.S. West Coast unleaded gasoline and diesel prices drifted lower Thursday, tracking a downward move in NYMEX products prices on the day, traders said.

"The market is moving lower on the Merc," one trader said, referring to a 1.87 cent a gallon drop in March heating oil and 2.24 cent decline in front-month unleaded gasoline in NYMEX trade in the floor session.
The drop was not as severe in the West Coast spot markets, where CARB gasoline was talked 77.50/78.50 cents a gallon in Los Angeles and 76/77 cents a gallon in San Francisco.
Low sulphur diesel was bid 76.50 cents a gallon in L.A and one cent a gallon stronger in the Bay Area.
